2:6.text: Verily, those who disbelieve, it is the same to them whether you
warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.

2:7.text: Allâh has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing,
(i.e. they are closed from accepting Allâh’s Guidance)
, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be a great torment.

2:8.text: And of mankind, there are some
who say: "We believe in Allâh and the Last Day" while in fact they believe not.

2:9.text: deceive Allâh and those who believe, while they only deceive themselves, and perceive

2:10.text: In their hearts is a disease
and Allâh has increased their disease. A painful torment is theirs because they used to tell lies.

2:11.text: And when it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "We are only peace-makers."

2:12.text: Verily! They are the ones who make mischief, but they perceive not.

2:13.text: And when it is said to them
(followers of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, Al-Ansâr and Al-Muhajirûn)
have believed," they say: "Shall we believe as the fools have believed?" Verily, they are the fools, but they know not.

2:14.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say: "We believe," but when they are alone with their Shayâtîn
, they say: "Truly, we are with you; verily, we were but mocking."

2:15.text: Allâh mocks at them and gives them increase in their wrong-doing to wander blindly.

2:16.text: These are they who have purchased error for guidance, so their commerce was profitless. And they were not guided.
